items.title: API Keys Exposed in Repository
items.description: Real API keys and secrets found in .env file and documentation
items.impact: Unauthorized access to trading accounts, potential financial loss
items.remediation: Revoke all exposed keys immediately, remove from git history, implement secrets management

items.title: Insecure Deserialization - Code Execution Risk
items.description: pickle.loads() used on potentially untrusted data
items.impact: Arbitrary code execution if attacker injects malicious pickled data
items.remediation: Replace with JSON + HMAC signature verification

items.title: No Stop-Loss Tests
items.impact: Stop-loss logic could fail silently, leading to uncontrolled losses
items.remediation: Add comprehensive tests for stop-loss logic with edge cases

items.title: Missing Position Size Validation
items.description: No validation that position size doesn't exceed available capital
items.remediation: Add position size validation in all trade execution paths

items.title: Weak Secret Key Configuration
items.description: Empty default for SECRET_KEY, placeholder values not changed
items.impact: JWT tokens can be forged, encryption broken
items.remediation: Implement SECRET_KEY validation, require minimum 32 characters

items.title: Bare Except Statement
items.description: Bare except catches all exceptions including SystemExit and KeyboardInterrupt
items.impact: Hides critical errors, makes debugging impossible
items.remediation: Replace with specific exception types and proper logging

items.title: God Object - Profile Batch Backtester
items.impact: Hard to test, maintain, and understand
items.remediation: Refactor into 5-6 separate classes with single responsibilities

items.title: God Object - Drift Detector
items.description: 2198 lines, 18 methods, implements 7 different detection algorithms
items.impact: Monolithic code, difficult to extend with new detectors
items.remediation: Extract into separate detector classes with registry pattern

items.title: Missing Position Sizing Tests
items.description: Core position sizing logic has insufficient test coverage (25%)
items.impact: Bugs in position sizing could cause capital depletion
items.remediation: Add comprehensive unit tests for all position sizing methods

items.title: Database Persistence Not Implemented
items.impact: Positions lost on restart, no recovery mechanism
items.remediation: Implement database persistence for position monitoring

items.title: Corporate Actions Not Persisted
items.description: Position adjustments after corporate actions not persisted to database
items.impact: Position integrity issues after splits, dividends, etc.
items.remediation: Implement database persistence for corporate action adjustments

items.title: Magic Numbers - RSI Thresholds
items.description: RSI thresholds (30, 45, 55, 70) hardcoded in multiple locations
items.impact: Cannot tune without code changes, inconsistent values

items.title: Magic Numbers - Risk Parameters
items.description: Stop loss (5%), take profit (10%), leverage (1.5x) hardcoded
items.impact: Cannot adjust risk parameters without code deployment

items.title: Missing IBacktestRunner Interface
items.description: BacktestEngine and ComprehensiveBacktestRunner have no common interface
items.impact: Cannot mock for testing, no polymorphism
items.remediation: Create IBacktestRunner interface with run_backtest() and validate_config() methods

items.title: Missing IDataSource Interface
items.description: Multiple data source implementations without unified interface
items.impact: Cannot swap data sources, tight coupling
items.remediation: Create IDataSource interface with fetch_quotes() and fetch_historical() methods

immediate: Revoke all exposed API keys immediately
Add position size validation to all trade execution paths
urgent: Implement missing database persistence for position monitoring
Add connection string sanitization before logging
high_priority: Refactor God Objects (19 files) - start with profile_batch_backtester.py (2887 lines)
Extract magic numbers to config (157+ instances)
Add comprehensive error handling (replace generic Exception)
medium_priority: Add circuit breaker pattern for broker APIs
